item.title: Liux’s Big microcar bets on sustainability to take on Chinese rivals
item.description: The Liux Big microcar is made in Spain. The startup thinks it can compete in a crowded market with its tiny electric car built around sustainability.

item.title: How to adjust the audio settings for your AirPods (and why you should)
item.description: If you want to enhance the sound of your AirPods even further, we've got you. Let's dig into some settings that will level up your listening experience.

item.title: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is now on its way to study the 'dark universe'
item.description: Its first images are expected to arrive in early 2027.

item.title: Norway deploys anti-drone C-UAS system to defend air bases hosting its new F-35 jets from threats
item.description: Norway has activated its first dedicated autonomous counter-drone system near Trondheim, protecting an air base expected to host F-35 fighters.

item.title: I hit 40 and knew my lifestyle had to change. This app is helping me power up, take more steps, and supercharge my water intake
item.description: Homescreen Heroes: GO Club helps you make simple health improvements that are actually achievable

item.title: Not the GameCube, not the Wii U: This was Nintendo's most unsuccessful console
item.description: Nintendo's worst-ever console was awkward to use and didn't even sell a million units. But you can try it today if you're curious.

item.title: Test de la Bambu Lab A2L : l’imprimante 3D grand format qui sait aussi découper
item.description: Bambu Lab descend le grand format sous la barre des 400 euros, et y ajoute deux modules qui transforment l'imprimante en machine de découpe et en traceur. Après plusieurs semaines de test, la promesse tient, à condition d'avoir la place et d'accepter le cloud du constructeur.

item.title: Cette enceinte Sony se place autour du cou, est compatible Dolby Atmos et perd la moitié de son prix
item.description: La Sony Bravia Theatre U compte parmi les enceintes les plus originales du marché, puisqu'elle prend place autour du cou, sur les épaules. Si ce modèle insolite vous tente, sachez qu'Amazon le propose à 149,99 euros au lieu de 299 euros.

item.title: Stop getting bad YouTube recommendations with 4 simple steps
item.description: If your algorithm is out of whack recently, there are things you can do to get it back on track with content you like.
